mapper.select: SELECT d.emp01_company_id AS company_id , d.emp01_person_id AS person_id , d.emp01_kor_nm AS kor_nm , d.emp01_mobile_telno AS mobile_telno , d.emp01_lock_yn AS lock_yn FROM sys25_password a INNER JOIN sys01_company c ON (a.sys25_company_id = c.sys01_company_id AND sys01_loc_nm = #{companyCode}) INNER JOIN emp01_person d ON (a.sys25_person_id = d.emp01_person_id AND d.emp01_emp_no = #{empNo} AND REPLACE(d.emp01_mobile_telno,'-','') = REPLACE(#{phone},'-','')) WHERE sys25_seq = ( SELECT MAX(sys.sys25_seq) FROM sys25_password sys WHERE sys.sys25_company_id = c.sys01_company_id AND sys.sys25_person_id = d.emp01_person_id )

SELECT p.emp01_company_id AS company_id , p.emp01_person_id AS person_id , p.emp01_kor_nm AS kor_nm , p.emp01_mobile_telno AS mobile_telno , p.emp01_lock_yn AS lock_yn FROM emp01_person p INNER JOIN sys01_company c ON c.sys01_company_id = p.emp01_company_id WHERE c.sys01_loc_nm = #{companyCode} AND p.emp01_emp_no = #{loginId}

SELECT CASE WHEN #{password} = TO_DECRYPTS(sys25_pwd) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN sys25_password ON emp01_person_id = sys25_person_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON emp01_company_id = sys01_company_id WHERE sys01_loc_nm = #{companyCode} AND emp01_emp_no = #{loginId} AND sys25_seq In ( SELECT MAX(sys25_seq) FROM sys25_password WHERE sys25_company_id = emp01_company_id AND sys25_person_id = emp01_person_id )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys25_password a WHERE a.sys25_person_id = #{personId} AND a.sys25_pwd IS NOT NULL AND a.sys25_seq = ( SELECT MAX(s.sys25_seq) FROM sys25_password s WHERE s.sys25_person_id = #{personId} )
